set.body:
Deliver ProfileHrf with one constrained shape per voxel shared across every trial and condition, signed condition means and condition-centered trial deviations. Include a general structured backend preserving Gaussian/LWU and explicit half-cosine admission, plus the new continuous-time Cascade34 family and exact seven-state innovation backend. Make compiled preparation reusable across voxels and stream final trial amplitudes.

Ownership: hrf owns scalar scientific families/normalization/shape derivatives and realization recipes; design owns stable trial/condition/run axes, Pulse and complete drives; model owns a shape-aware declarative plan; fit/profile owns compilation, likelihood jets, bounded decoding, readout and diagnostics. Generic banded factors/solvers stay in standalone Gale. Do not reinterpret the fixed-design FitPlan or LSS TrialReadout as a response-independent map for an adaptive estimator.

Scientific contract: ordinary ridge then release [F,XM] exactly; lambda>0 with explicit fixed-mean rank checks; separate PenalizedProfile and constrained TrialRandomEffectsML with full K=I+XPX'/lambda determinant. The nuisance-error-contrast determinant is a different criterion. Freeze noise scale/lambda/observation geometry in v1. State branches share each trial impulse. Cascade34 is g3(t,kp)-rho*g4(t,ku), kp>ku>0, rho>=0, causal, positive-component-unit-area normalization; rho is area ratio and rho=0 leaves the tail rate unidentified. Gaussian/LWU are not replaced by a cascade approximation. Half-cosine has six native parameters and moving C2 failures; only declared smooth 2-3 parameter charts/cells enter the local decoder.

Epic acceptance criteria:
1. Independent direct normal-equation, covariance and state-space oracles pass for every admitted family/backend on JVM and JS. Well-conditioned fixed-shape solves/inverses/logdets meet abs+relative 1e-10-scale contracts; derivatives pass justified step-sweep/AD checks (initial relative/absolute scaled targets 1e-6 gradient, 1e-5 Hessian). Ill-conditioned inputs return explicit diagnostics rather than loose tolerances hiding failure.
2. Exact continuous Cascade34 transitions, on/off-grid impulse injection, common branch covariance, derivatives, innovation profile, full ML determinant correction, prepared-shape and bounded continuous readout are covered. Ordinary BoxHeight/BoxMass convolution may be supported while their random-amplitude finite-state backend is explicitly unadmitted.
3. Bounded decoder checks feasibility, curvature, rank, original-model approximation, boundary/ambiguity and prior dominance. Local algebraic exactness is not claimed as global nonlinear exactness or calibrated confidence. Full trial coefficients retain stable IDs and condition means; conditional and adaptive readout contracts differ.
4. Stream results with bounded memory; preserve observation/run/censor geometry, normalize consistently, protect training-fold/pilot boundaries, and emit separate identification, approximation and preparation receipts. No OLS t/F or invented df is attached to penalized adaptive estimates.
5. Complete numerical, scientific calibration and performance courts on exact source/provider revisions. Run affected JVM+JS suites and laws/scenarios, then compileAll/testAll for integration. Pending or unrelated failures are reported as boundaries, never called passing.
6. Document a runnable end-to-end example and all eligible families, unsupported cases, measured budgets and uncertainty scope. Required children must close with evidence before the release gate and this epic close. Optional optimizations are recorded separately and are not hidden v1 prerequisites.

Existing work to reuse without duplication: transactional result sink/catalog bd-01KX6G9B8R86MRBZ9S8K8F5G7V; uncertainty provenance bd-01M210WJ4BWVCXEMTARHDR2AC7; known-truth first-level calibration bd-01M21VA8DYMNJS9PZ8076SBWWJ. Local Gale admission is a consumer gate; native provider implementation belongs in Gale and cross-store issue IDs are provenance only.

Current evidence: research Python checks support algebra, discrete filter derivatives and continuous Cascade34 transition/off-grid covariance identities. No production Scala implementation, broad-domain accuracy or throughput is claimed.

Performance goals and benchmark contract (targets, not achieved results):
- B0 representative case: T=600 observations, N=300 trials, C=3 conditions, 6 full-rank fixed regressors, V=100,000 voxels, d=3, r=7 for Cascade34; Float64 computation and Float32 trial output (120 MB decimal). Stream generated/input responses and outputs. Freeze sparse and dense event schedules, lambda, noise transform, family domains, reference cells and seeds before optimization. Also run N=1,200 and V=10,000/20,000/100,000 scaling cases.
- Hard bounded-execution contract: bank <=8 prepared references per geometry; <=2 references evaluated per voxel; one second-order amplitude residual correction; at most one additional reference solve for residual certification. Count all score/readout/certification work. No per-voxel N-by-N or T-by-T factorization, no per-voxel covariance-gain preparation, no unbounded nonlinear fallback. State scoring has no trial-sized derivative solves. One shared observation geometry in v1; unsupported geometry fails explicitly.
- Engine live-memory goal <=256 MiB for B0, including prepared reference bank and all active worker buffers, with block size <=256 voxels per worker and <=8 workers. Exclude VM/runtime baseline and files on disk, not buffers or retained result payloads. Report whole-process peak RSS separately. Increasing V from 10,000 to 100,000 at fixed concurrency/block size should add <=max(32 MiB,10% of baseline engine live memory). No N*d*V derivative field, no retained V-sized collection of amplitude blocks; small scalar receipts are allowed.
- Steady-state compute scaling goal: doubling V from 10,000 to 20,000 costs <=2.3x at fixed geometry, threads and backend, with IO reported separately. Finite-state score-only time at fixed T,C,F,d,r and reference count should change <=20% when N grows 300->1,200 after preparation; report event preparation and terminal O(N) readout separately.
- Relative runtime goals: complete one-reference profile+readout <=12x the same backend's exact fixed-shape fit+trial readout; two-reference <=24x. On the frozen dense-overlap case, finite-state observed-Hessian score+readout target >=3x faster than the general observed-Hessian backend, comparing the SAME Cascade34 kernel, observation geometry, criterion and admitted approximation budget. Report sparse-case crossover; do not replace a family or relax accuracy to win.
- Absolute engineering target: B0 complete two-reference Cascade34 profile+readout+certification <=120 seconds on the declared CPU-only JVM baseline (up to 8 workers, >=32 GiB host RAM), excluding input acquisition and disk persistence; report preparation and complete IO-inclusive elapsed time separately. Record exact CPU, OS, JDK, heap, compiler/provider revisions and power/thread settings. Freeze the actual reference host in PHRF-01 before measurement. This is a proposed target, not a hardware-independent promise.
- JVM and Scala.js both run correctness and relative scaling courts; JS uses one worker and at least V=10,000, with its absolute throughput reported separately. Timing: no build/startup in steady-state compute; warm up until stable, record >=5 measured runs, median/p95, allocations/GC, preparation and IO. Cold preparation is separately reported.
- Accuracy co-gate: benchmark the complete attempted cohort, not accepted cases selected afterwards. On the preregistered local well-identified cohort target >=95% admitted, with p95 decoded-vs-nonlinear-oracle peak latency <=0.02 s and FWHM <=0.05 s, p95 relative trial amplitude L2 error <=0.1%; enforce declared original-system residual/score budgets. Undefined summaries and deliberate ambiguity cases are assessed separately, never silently removed. These are approximation-agreement targets, not claims of real-fMRI precision.
- An unmet target stays visible as failed/unmet. Revise targets only through an explicit evidence-backed decision recording old/new values and tradeoff; do not close performance qualification on asymptotic arguments or a smoke run.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md (SHA256 bb6b56efab0d251b287ec0d315112103c2213434a489625def8c2ccc9b35293c). Research probe: tools/validation/profile_hrf_review.py (SHA256 03be9eab54b76c0076ced2fe4deb26ab00fe4259536284833ae53971a5a61c9d). These are local review artifacts, not a released estimator. The source proposal numerical tables were unavailable; only independently reproduced checks count as evidence.
set.title: EPIC: ProfileHrf trial-shape fitting with exact seven-state Cascade34
